config.purpose: Connect with seed-stage founders and open a conversation about Crew.

steps.note: Warm-up touch. Also fills in name/headline/company/degree for every later step.
Drop bad fits BEFORE spending an invite on them. Invites are the scarcest resource.

params.icp: Founder, co-founder or CEO at a startup under ~30 people, ideally pre-Series-A. Not agencies, not recruiters, not coaches, not enterprise employees with a founder-sounding title.

steps.note: Writes the invite note. Does not send it — the invite step below consumes it.

params.brief: Open a conversation with {{first_name}}. One specific reference to what they are building, then a light ask to compare notes. No pitch.
params.tone: peer to peer, plain, slightly informal

steps.note: The rate-limited step. Everything above exists to make this one count.
The gate. Nobody reaches a message step until LinkedIn says they are 1st-degree.
Do not message the same hour they accept.

params.brief: {{first_name}} just accepted. Thank them briefly, say in one sentence what Crew does, and ask one genuine question about their current biggest bottleneck.

steps.note: This is the wait AND the reply detector. A plain delay here would follow up on people who already answered.
Only reached by people who did not reply within 96 hours.

params.body: No worries if the timing is off, {{first_name}} — I'll leave it here. If it's ever useful, the door's open.
